text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Construction of an iron ore reduction plant is to begin next April in the Mozambican port city of Beira. A new port linked to the project will be built at Savane, 25 kilometres north of Beira.

- The process of privatising Mozambique's short-haul airline, Transporte e Trabalho Aereo, ended on Tuesday with the formal handover of the line to the consortium which won the tender. The handover should have taken place at the beginning of this month but was held up by problems concerning employees' pay.

- The Mozambican customs service says it has reached an understanding with small-scale importers following a confrontation on Monday when importers used their vehicles to blockade a customs depot near Maputo. The importers had claimed that customs staff were imposing arbitrary fines and delaying clearing their goods.
